title: Soils
seo_title: Year 3 Science: Soils Worksheets (Rocks, Humus, Sandy and Clay Soil)
standard_text: Recognise that soils are made from rocks and organic matter.
meta_desc: Free Year 3 science worksheets on soils: what soil is made of, humus, sandy, clay and loam soils, soil layers, earthworms and the drainage test. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Sandy soil drains fast; clay soil holds water.
body_html:
How to think about it

Soil is made from tiny pieces of rock mixed with organic matter.

  • Soil also has air, water and living things such as worms. Humus is rotted plant and animal material.
  • Sandy soil drains quickly; clay soil holds water; loam is a good mixture for most plants.
  • Topsoil is on top, then subsoil, then solid bedrock.
Example

Water drains fastest through?

Big grains, big gaps

Answer: sandy soil

Example

What is humus?

From living things

Answer: rotted plants and animals

Common mistakes

  • Thinking soil is just dirt with nothing in it.
  • Thinking all soils are the same.
  • Thinking clay soil drains fastest.

faq.a: Tiny pieces of rock mixed with humus (rotted plants and animals), air, water and living things such as worms.

faq.q: What is the difference between sandy and clay soil?
faq.a: Sandy soil has big grains, so water drains through quickly. Clay soil has tiny grains packed together, so it holds water and feels sticky.

faq.q: Why are earthworms good for soil?
faq.a: They mix the soil, make tunnels for air and water, and break down dead leaves into nutrients for plants.
